name: pcgpg
finding: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-H05 (paged call-gate param copy: page-straddling frames/sources, old-context faults)
gate_form: DIFFERENTIAL (step-7 full-stream compare vs the QEMU golden) + a recommended step-7e-style faultlog extra (exactly two #PFs: err=00000002 then err=00000000, no #GP/#DF). Paged protected mode, 4 KiB pages, identity map [0,1MiB) P|RW|US. The fault cases are FULLY differential (pxprobe's result: QEMU unwinds the half-done stack switch and faults in the OLD context, and the RTL's S_INT_PROBE/S_CG_PRD classification is supervisor), so no witness-only grading is needed; CR2 is privileged state and is graded by the stream diff (every post-fault record carries it).
matrix_rows: phase A (destination straddle, success): TSS.ESP0 = 0x8100E (unaligned), 24-byte frame (pcount 2) at [0x80FF6,0x8100D] straddling pages 0x80/0x81; the param[0] push at 0x80FFE straddles WITHIN one beat (fx fragment engine split write across two pages). S_INT_PROBE proves the extent, the transfer completes, cA verifies all six frame slots via flat absolute reads and returns `lret $8`

phase B (source straddle, success): caller ESP = 0x70FFE, so S_CG_PRD's param[0] dword read at 0x70FFE straddles pages 0x70/0x71 (fx split READ with merge), both present. cB verifies, then tears down PT0[0x81] and PT0[0x71] (PTE <- 0, CR3 reload) for the fault phases and re-arms TSS.ESP0 = 0x8100E

phase C (destination frame's top page NOT PRESENT): the S_INT_PROBE extent probe raises #PF BEFORE the SS/CPL commit -- OLD context fully intact: err = 2 ({US=0,W=1,P=0}, the frame pushes are implicit SUPERVISOR writes), CR2 = 0x8100A (the FIRST push's address; QEMU faults on its first push at the same address). Delivered same-privilege to the CPL3 pf3_handler, which records the frame, arms phase D's TSS.ESP0 = 0x83000, skips the 7-byte lcall and IRETs back

phase D (param SOURCE page NOT PRESENT): param[1]'s S_CG_PRD read at 0x71000 faults -- err = 0 (supervisor READ, P=0), CR2 = 0x71000, OLD context, ZERO frame bytes written (QEMU pushed SS/ESP on the new stack before its own faulting read, but unwinds the delivery the same way and those bytes are never read back). Same handler path; then the CPL3 exit
transitions: real->protected, GDT @ 0x500 (10 entries: code0/data0/code3/data3 flat, TSS 0x28 base 0x3000, four 32-bit call gates 0x30/0x38/0x40/0x48 type 0xC DPL3 pcount 2 -> cA/cB/cA/cA)
IDT @ 0x1000: #PF(14) -> pf3_handler (trap 0x8F DPL0, CS=0x1B: SAME-priv at CPL3), #GP(13) -> gp_catch (diagnostic exit, never fires on the golden path)
TSS @ 0x3000 SS0=0x10 ESP0=0x8100E; LTR; PD @ 0x10000 -> PT0 @ 0x11000 identity [0,1MiB) P|RW|US; CR3 load + CR0.PG 0->1
inter-privilege IRET down to CPL3 (SS=0x23, ESP=0x70000, EFLAGS=0x3002 IOPL=3, CS=0x1B)
phases A-D as in matrix_rows; isa-debug-exit (status 133) at CPL==IOPL==3

witnesses.final_record: edi=0x00000002 (phase C #PF error code: supervisor write, not-present), esi=0x00000000 (phase D #PF error code: supervisor read, not-present), ecx=0xa5000000 (phase A param[0], split-written across pages 0x80/0x81), ebp=0xa5000010 (phase B param[0], split-READ across pages 0x70/0x71), ebx=0xc6a0000a (phase A return-ESP flag), esp=0x00070ffc, cs=0x001b, ss=0x0023, cr2=0x00071000 (phase D's faulting source read)
witnesses.cr2_midstream: cr2=0x0008100a in every record between phase C's fault and phase D's fault (the first faulting push's address; QEMU-measured semantics)
witnesses.markers: phase A frame slots at 0x2000-0x201C (retEIP=afterA, CS=0x1B, p0=0xA5000000, p1=0xA5000001, old ESP=0x70000, old SS=0x23, new ESP=0x80FF6, new SS=0x10); phase B at 0x2020-0x2034 (p0=0xA5000010, p1=0xA5000011, old ESP=0x70FFE, old SS=0x23, new ESP=0x83FE8); return flags 0x2038=0xC6A0000A (ESP=0x70008), 0x203C=0xC6A0000B (ESP=0x71006 -- QEMU's imm16 double-add); phase C fault frame at 0x2100-0x210C (err=2, EIP=lcallC, CS=0x1B, handler ESP=0x6FFF0 = the USER stack, proving the old-context delivery); phase D at 0x2110-0x211C (err=0, EIP=lcallD, CS=0x1B, ESP=0x70FEC)
witnesses.faultlog: EXACTLY TWO lines, measured on the fixed build: '[FAULT] vec=14 err=00000002 pc=000f0301 state=33 (S_WALK) depth=0' (phase C) then '[FAULT] vec=14 err=00000000 pc=000f0317 state=33 depth=0' (phase D); ZERO vec=8/vec=13 (no escalation cascade, nothing half-committed)

negative_control.method: HEAD build (git archive HEAD rtl; OBJDIR=obj_dir_h05head)
negative_control.measured: CONFIRMED 2026-08-04: the HEAD trace retires 3766 records and stops (quiesce); the last retired instruction is at 0x000F0296, the store immediately BEFORE phase A's lcall through the pcount-2 gate (0x000F029B) -- the 0xDA loud-halt. compare.py: DIVERGENT (length mismatch: golden 3866 vs HEAD 3766). (The down-transfer uses an inter-privilege IRET, not an outer RETF, deliberately: HEAD predates the REVIEW_Aug3 C-02 S_RETF outer-beat cur_lin mirror and hangs there under paging, which would have masked the 0xDA halt this control is about.)

rtl_blockers: SAME as pcgparam (see its manifest for the full analysis + validated fixes): cA's `lret $8` trips blocker1 on the canonical build -- the outer ESP/SS pops read SP+2w/SP+3w without the imm16 addend, so the popped SS is the param dword 0xA5000001 (selector 0x0001 after masking: null-class, #GP(0)) and the machine exits through gp_catch with eax=0. Divergence at n=3785 pc=0x000F03A8. All four phases' gate machinery (probe, fx split write, fx split read, param copy, both old-context #PFs with the right err/CR2) matches QEMU on the canonical build; with the two scratch patches the full 3866-record stream is EQUIVALENT.
validation: Golden: 3866 records, exit 133, the witnesses above. Canonical TB: DIVERGENT at n=3785 (blocker1) -- RED until the pcgparam-documented fixes land. Scratch-fixed TB: EQUIVALENT (3866/3866). HEAD TB: DIVERGENT (0xDA halt at phase A), the negative control. Sweep-clean under +define+VEN_SEG_ENFORCE (obj_dir_seg, 1200-insn prefix): SEGCHK=0, no PAGING/C-0* assertions.
description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-H05 regression, image 3 of 3: paged call-gate parameter copy -- a destination frame whose param push straddles a page boundary within one beat (fx split write), a param source straddling a page boundary (fx split read), and the two old-context fault forms (destination top page not present -> #PF err=2 CR2=first-push; source page not present -> #PF err=0 CR2=source), each delivered same-privilege to a CPL3 witness handler. Fully differential vs the pinned QEMU golden; the faultlog extra pins exactly-two-#PFs-no-cascade.
